text:
emma: Heads-up: I put a final draft of release 175 notes in the doc. Need a quick lock and confirmation on rollback steps + announce timing.

samir: where is the doc?

emma: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/drafts/175-final. Please comment inline.

olivia: reading. Two things: clarify which model hashes are safe to hot-swap and which require DB migration review.

mike: also add the exact metric check we use for canary health (p95 latency, error-rate).

nate: deploy-bot, please stage a canary run and set geo-phase.

deploy-bot: [bot] scheduled staging job: release/175 at 2024-09-20T02:30Z. Canary: 5% -> 20% phased. Phase order: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Auto-fallback on trigger enabled.

jen: copy draft for internal announce: "Release 175 rolling out with inference perf and cost optimizations. No user-visible changes expected. Standby: @nate @samir @olivia." Thoughts?

lily: add where to find dashboards + runbooks: Console -> Releases -> 175, and the rollback runbook link.

samir: change window: originally midnight-02:00 PT. Is that okay with EU jobs?

emma: EU nightly ETL runs 01:30-02:20 PT. Moving to 02:30-04:30 PT to be safe. Update notes and announce.

olivia: rollback triggers proposed: >5% error increase OR >25% p95 latency regression sustained for 5m. That ok?

mike: can we make error threshold absolute (e.g., >1.5% total errors) to avoid noisy percent deltas on low-baseline endpoints?

olivia: good point. I'll change to: error-rate >1.5% AND >5% relative increase.

nate: exact rollback steps in runbook:
1) route traffic to fallback model: `redwood-cli routes set --model model-redwood/v2-fp16`
2) disable batching opt: `infra toggle batching --release 175 off`
3) if dedicated pool misbehaves, revert pool config: `kubectl apply -f pools/legacy-config.yaml`
4) if still degraded escalate to oncall and consider pin to older model digest.

samir: include owners for each step and expected RTO per step.

emma: done in doc. Also adding model pin info: primary pin `model-redwood/v2-q1` (sha256:8f3a7ab2...), fallback `model-redwood/v2-fp16` (sha256:1c9d4f2e...).

jen: deploy-bot: please add label `release/175/ready` after Emma locks notes.

deploy-bot: [bot] reminder scheduled: apply label when channel message includes `LOCKED` and checklist items marked.

lily: microcopy: internal announce should include quick TL;DR, linked checklist, and contact mentions. Keep it 1-2 lines.

emma: proposed final internal announce (T-30m):
"LOCKED: Release 175 deploying 02:30 PT. Inference performance & cost improvements. No user-facing changes expected. Standby: @nate @olivia @samir. Dashboards: console/releases/175. Runbook: docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/release-175."

mike: LGTM.

olivia: QA: will post load test summary and hash-verification by 16:00 PT.

nate: infra will attach canary dashboards and enable phased geo rollout.

emma: locking notes now unless objections. If none Ill mark `LOCKED` and trigger deploy-bot label at 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:

samir: no objections from me.

jen: Ill post internal announce T-30 in #all-hands and pin the doc.

emma: thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: [bot] action: when label `release/175/ready` applied, automated canary will run per schedule. Be sure to update checklist.

jen: one last reminder  include rollback command snippet in the pinned message for quick copy-paste.

emma: will add the snippet. Locking now.

(END)
